challengeTitle: Severe shortage of safe drinking water for 450 students in Government High School, Ormanjhi

proposal.proposedSolution: Solar-Powered Nanofiltration & Activated Alumina Community Drinking Water Kiosk with Real-time IoT Turbidity and Fluoride Telemetry
proposal.problemAnalysis: Groundwater at the school shows fluoride concentration of 3.4 mg/L (safe limit < 1.0 mg/L) and high iron turbidity (8.2 NTU). Conventional boiling or chlorine is ineffective against fluoride. A decentralized modular nanofiltration system powered by a 1.2 kW solar array provides 2,000 liters/day of WHO-compliant drinking water.
technologyRequired: IoT ESP32 Water Telemetry Node with GSM modem
requiredResources: Stainless Steel food-grade storage tank (1,000 L)
proposal.expectedImpact: Ensures 100% safe fluoride-free water for 450 students, 18 teachers, and 600 neighboring villagers; eliminates waterborne fluorosis absenteeism.
proposal.prototypeRequirement: Weather-proof solar skid mounting, pump housing enclosure, and certified membrane pressure vessel fabrication.
proposal.technicalRequirements: Flow rate 250 LPH, recovery rate > 75%, solar autonomy 2 days battery backup.

industrySupport.resourcesProvided: Fabricated SS304 skid enclosure, solar battery rack, sponsored raw membrane vessels, and certified lab water assay.

milestones.title: Groundwater Sample Testing & Chemical Speciation
milestones.description: Baseline fluoride, iron, TDS, and coliform microbiological analysis completed at BIT Mesra lab.

milestones.title: CAD Design & Skid Prototype Engineering
milestones.description: CAD design approved by TSRDS engineering team for modular transport.

milestones.title: Membrane Skid Fabrication & IoT Integration
milestones.description: Assembly of filtration columns, solar inverter, and ESP32 telemetry transmitter at TSRDS workshop.

milestones.title: Field Pilot Installation & Mukhiya Handover
milestones.description: On-site plumbing, tank connection, and training of school caretaker in filter backwashing.

impactReport.beforeDescription: School children drank turbid tap water with 3.4 mg/L fluoride, causing dental mottled enamel and frequent stomach infections.
impactReport.afterDescription: Solar-automated clean water dispenser operational with 0.4 mg/L safe fluoride and 0 NTU turbidity.
impactReport.socialImpact: Student attendance increased by 22%; zero waterborne illness incidents reported.
impactReport.environmentalImpact: Zero plastic waste generated; solar powered with 0 kg CO2 grid emissions.

challengeTitle: Damaged culvert causing flash flooding and cutting off access to Primary Health Centre

proposal.proposedSolution: Precast Blast Furnace Slag Geopolymer Modular Box Culvert with Scour-Resilient Wing Walls
proposal.problemAnalysis: Old brick masonry culvert collapsed under peak monsoon runoff of 14 m³/s. Soil erosion undercut the approach road. Replacing with precast geopolymer blocks utilizing 70% industrial blast furnace slag resists acidic rainwater and cures in 48 hours.
proposal.expectedImpact: Restores 24/7 all-weather ambulance and tractor connectivity to 4 villages (population 3,800) and the Ghatshila Sub-divisional hospital.
proposal.prototypeRequirement: Full-scale precast modular box units cast at JRIC yard and transported by flatbed trailer.
proposal.technicalRequirements: IRC:SP:13 hydraulic design compliance, Class 70R live vehicle loading capacity.

industrySupport.resourcesProvided: Provided precast concrete casting yard space, mobile 20-ton crane for placement, and geo-membrane fabric roll.

milestones.title: Hydraulic Catchment Modeling & Soil Bearing Test
milestones.description: Peak discharge recalculated for 50-year storm event.

milestones.title: Casting of Precast Slag-Concrete Modular Blocks
milestones.description: Six box culvert segments successfully cast at JRIC casting yard.

milestones.title: Site Excavation & Crane Assembly
milestones.description: Modules positioned on compacted gravel bed; wing walls secured.

milestones.title: Load Testing & Commissioning
milestones.description: Tested with 25-ton laden truck; deflection measured < 1.2mm.

impactReport.beforeDescription: Collapsing culvert caused 3-foot waterlogging every monsoon, forcing a 14 km detour for ambulances.
impactReport.afterDescription: Heavy-duty eco-slag culvert in place with smooth paved approach ramp and safety guard rails.
impactReport.socialImpact: Ambulance response time reduced from 55 minutes to 12 minutes.
impactReport.environmentalImpact: Utilized 12 tons of industrial blast furnace slag diverted from landfills.

challengeTitle: Overflowing organic and plastic garbage dump near Topchanchi weekly market polluting water body

proposal.proposedSolution: Decentralized Solar-Assisted Rapid Bio-Composting Drum and Waste Plastic Compression Paver Machine
proposal.problemAnalysis: Weekly vegetable haat produces 1.8 tons of perishable wet waste and 300 kg of thin single-use plastic. Open burning generates toxic dioxins. A continuous rotational aerobic composting drum decomposes wet waste in 12 days into nutrient-rich organic manure for local farmers, while plastic is shredded and blended with fly-ash into durable walkway pavers.
technologyRequired: Rotary Aerobic Drum Bio-Digester with solar heating jacket
Dual-Shaft Shredder for multi-layer plastic pouches
proposal.expectedImpact: Eliminates 2.1 tons of weekly market waste, produces 600 kg high-grade organic fertilizer weekly, and prevents leachate discharge into Topchanchi lake.
proposal.prototypeRequirement: Steel drum casing with safety interlocks and trailer-hitch mobility.
proposal.technicalRequirements: Processing capacity 400 kg/day, internal thermophilic temperature 55-65°C, solar PV assist.

industrySupport.resourcesProvided: Provided precision hydraulic press, industrial shredder blades, and sponsored local SHG training.

milestones.title: Microbial Inoculant Formulation & Haat Waste Characterization
milestones.description: Identified high organic fraction suitable for thermophilic decomposition.

milestones.title: Rotary Drum Composter Fabrication
milestones.description: Drum fabricated with insulated solar heat-trapping acrylic hood.

milestones.title: Plastic Shredder & Paver Press Assembly
milestones.description: Integrated at EcoTech workshop; produced initial batch of 500 pavers.

milestones.title: Gram Panchayat Operator Training
milestones.description: Trained 6 members of Mahila Self Help Group on composting operation and manure bagging.

impactReport.beforeDescription: Market ground had an overflowing 40-foot garbage heap attracting stray cattle and washing filth into the water canal.
impactReport.afterDescription: Zero-waste market established; daily compost processing and paved pedestrian plaza using recycled plastic pavers.
impactReport.socialImpact: SHG generates ₹18,000 monthly income by selling certified vermicompost to nearby guava orchards.
impactReport.environmentalImpact: Diverts 1.8 tons of waste weekly; saved Topchanchi tributary canal from eutrophication.
